title: FiestaSwap
tagline: FiestaSwap is the only routing API widget you will ever need to provide swap from any ecosystems!
description:
This project allow any developer to integrate a routing widget in their website to allow users to swap seamlessly from any ecosystem (even outside of evm's)
Fun part is that a referal model is linked to it, the more you share it and the more the people use it, the more you earn

Let's swap!
how_its_made:
Using classic kit wallet and XDEFI routing technology to enable swap anywhere
We work on making it available as a webapp and widget to be integrated anywhere
We will add more here once we will have made it during the hackathon in the next month coming very soon please it needs that much
